alt: Poster: IT shares lead a modest close higher. Nifty 50 25,884.50 (+0.25%), Sensex 84,328.59 (+0.46%), Nifty IT +3.66%, 26 Nov 2026
text:
IT shares led a modest close higher on Thursday after benchmarks gave up early gains.

• Sensex closed at 84,328.59, up 390.31 points (0.46%); Nifty 50 closed at 25,884.50, up 65.25 points (0.25%), per Kotak Neo, InCred Money and HDFC Sky closing reports.
• Nifty IT rose 3.66%, the top sector in all three reports; Nifty FMCG fell 0.94% (per Kotak Neo and HDFC Sky) and Nifty Auto 0.69% (per HDFC Sky and InCred Money).
• Nifty Midcap 100 rose 0.32% (per Kotak Neo and InCred Money). HCL Technologies, TCS and Infosys were among the top Nifty 50 gainers (per Kotak Neo and HDFC Sky).
• Reports cited late-session selling after early gains, West Asia tensions and crude oil, and global cues. Exact figures for some indices differ slightly between reports, so we quote only those common to the sources.

Our view: when one sector does most of the lifting, the index can rise while many holdings do not follow. One session is a thin sample, so we read this as sector rotation, not a change of trend. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: when a single sector drives the index higher, how do you check whether a client's diversified portfolio actually participated?
